title: Tooltip
overview: A short peek on hover or focus. Not the only place values or legal copy live.
apply_when: A brief name or hint for a control that already has an accessible name.
not_when: The only values (charts), long legal copy, or a confirm (popconfirm / modal).

role.overview: A short hint on hover or focus. No decision required.
role.apply_when: A name or extra hint for a control that already has a name.
role.not_when: A confirm (popconfirm), a modal, or the only accessible name.

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: The tip describes a control that already has a name.
composition.apply_when: Icon buttons that already have aria-label; extra hint.
composition.not_when: The tooltip is the only name.

state.not_when: The tip stays in the tab order.

state.apply_when: Hover or focus on the trigger.
state.not_when: Shown only on hover so keyboard never sees it.

accessibility.overview: The control still has a name without the tooltip.
accessibility.not_when: Icon-only with title= as the only name.

accessibility.overview: Focus can show the same tip hover shows.
accessibility.apply_when: A hint they might need without a pointer.

keyboard.overview: Focusing the trigger shows the tip.

keyboard.not_when: Escape does nothing and the tip blocks the next control.
